run_rattle_test: run the main test to verify ASE rattle does not modify fixed atoms on a Cu slab
test_rattle_with_fixatoms: test that rattling an ASE atoms object respects FixAtoms constraints on selected atom indices
build_fcc_slab_with_adsorbate: build an FCC Cu(100) slab and add a CO molecule as an adsorbate using ASE
create_fixatoms_constraint: create a FixAtoms constraint to lock the bottom layers of an ASE slab by atom tag
review_rattle_test_main: review the main function that validates rattle behavior against fixed and free atom masks
